project.description: Report problems with publication files: empty files, publications with several Original Articles, the same file recorded more than once, and files named for another publication. The build is UNSTABLE when issues are found and FAILED only when the scan itself errors. Fix flags are off by default; each repairs one specific case and logs it to the updates table.

hudson.model.BooleanParameterDefinition.name: FIX_EMPTY_SUPERSEDED_ORIGINAL
hudson.model.BooleanParameterDefinition.description: Delete an empty Original Article row when the same publication has a non-empty Original Article.

hudson.model.BooleanParameterDefinition.name: FIX_EMPTY_PROMOTE_ZDBID_PDF
hudson.model.BooleanParameterDefinition.description: Delete an empty Original Article row when the publication has no non-empty Original Article but has a non-empty ZDB-PUB-xxxx.pdf of another type, and promote that file to Original Article.

hudson.model.BooleanParameterDefinition.name: FIX_IDENTICAL_ORIGINALS
hudson.model.BooleanParameterDefinition.description: When a publication has several Original Article rows whose files are byte-identical (same md5), delete all but the lowest-id row. Files on disk are not removed; rows with differing files are left alone.

hudson.model.BooleanParameterDefinition.name: FIX_DUPLICATE_FILES
hudson.model.BooleanParameterDefinition.description: When the same stored file is recorded more than once for a publication with the same type, delete all but the lowest-id row. The file on disk is not removed; rows for the same file with different types are left alone.

hudson.model.BooleanParameterDefinition.name: CHECK_IDENTICAL_CONTENT
hudson.model.BooleanParameterDefinition.description: Report identical content (md5): files of different names on one publication, and the same file on more than one publication. Reads the size of every publication file and hashes those whose size is shared, so it can be slow. Report only; changes nothing.

hudson.tasks.Shell.command: export ARTIFACTS_DIR=`pwd` echo "ARTIFACTS_DIR: $ARTIFACTS_DIR" TASK_ARGS="" if [ "$FIX_EMPTY_SUPERSEDED_ORIGINAL" = "true" ]; then TASK_ARGS="$TASK_ARGS --fix-empty-superseded-original"; fi if [ "$FIX_EMPTY_PROMOTE_ZDBID_PDF" = "true" ]; then TASK_ARGS="$TASK_ARGS --fix-empty-promote-zdbid-pdf"; fi if [ "$FIX_IDENTICAL_ORIGINALS" = "true" ]; then TASK_ARGS="$TASK_ARGS --fix-identical-originals"; fi if [ "$FIX_DUPLICATE_FILES" = "true" ]; then TASK_ARGS="$TASK_ARGS --fix-duplicate-files"; fi if [ "$CHECK_IDENTICAL_CONTENT" = "true" ]; then TASK_ARGS="$TASK_ARGS --check-identical-content"; fi rm -f publication_file_issues.csv publication_file_issues.xlsx fixed_publication_files.csv fixed_publication_files.xlsx cd $SOURCEROOT && gradle findPublicationFileIssuesTask -PtaskArgs="$TASK_ARGS" # The task exits 0 when it only finds issues, and fails (so the build FAILS) on an unexpected error. # Issues in the report (more than the header line) mean UNSTABLE: exit 3 (see unstableReturn). cd "$ARTIFACTS_DIR" if [ "$(wc -l < publication_file_issues.csv)" -gt 1 ]; then echo "Publication file issues found: marking the build UNSTABLE" exit 3 fi

email.subject: Publication file scan failed
email.body: The publication file scan failed unexpectedly. Build: ${BUILD_URL} Build log: ${BUILD_URL}console

email.subject: Publication file issues found
email.body: The publication file scan found issues (empty files, multiple Original Articles, duplicate file rows, or files named for another publication). Build: ${BUILD_URL} See the attached publication_file_issues.xlsx, or ${BUILD_URL}artifact/publication_file_issues.csv
